IGNORE_INDEX = -100

def mask_prompt_tokens(input_ids, prompt_len):
    labels = input_ids.copy()
    labels[:prompt_len] = [IGNORE_INDEX] * prompt_len
    return labels

# -100 positions are ignored by CrossEntropyLoss
